in_hebrew.name: Sax
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Sax הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English ‘sceaxe’, meaning ‘knife’, ‘sword’. Saxon name for one who wields a weapon, a protector or defender.

in_greek.name: Sax
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Protector, Defender
in_greek.long_meaning: Sax είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old English ‘sceaxe’, meaning ‘knife’, ‘sword’. Saxon name for one who wields a weapon, a protector or defender.

in_latin.name: Sax
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Protector, Defender
in_latin.long_meaning: Sax est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old English ‘sceaxe’, meaning ‘knife’, ‘sword’. Saxon name for one who wields a weapon, a protector or defender.
